results.title: Intermittent failure injected at the application boundary
results.trigger: failRate=0.4 on the SUT data routes for 40 requests
results.expected: Failures are reported, every failure is attributable to the injected fault, no request is silently passed, and the system returns to clean once the fault is removed
results.residualRisk: low: failures are attributable, but a real product error during an injection window would be indistinguishable from the injected fault

results.title: Shared authentication state across parallel flows
results.trigger: 4 concurrent writers to one account over 12 rounds, repeated with one account per writer
results.expected: With a shared account the collision is observable; with per-worker isolation no writer observes another writer’s value
results.residualRisk: low: coupling is reproducible and removed by isolation; a suite that still shares an account is not protected

results.title: A failure stripped of trace artefacts
results.trigger: diagnosis attempted against a failure whose trace bundle is absent
results.expected: The system reports insufficient evidence and declines to name a cause, instead of producing a confident but unsupported diagnosis
results.residualRisk: low: the failure mode is a refusal to diagnose, which is safe

results.title: Telemetry insufficient to identify the failing component
results.trigger: the network stream is removed from an otherwise complete trace bundle
results.expected: The gap is reported as a distinct outcome class naming the missing signal, not as a low-confidence diagnosis
results.residualRisk: low: the gap is named, so the operator knows which signal to add

results.title: Partial failure leaves desired and observed state inconsistent
results.trigger: dropResponseRate=0.5: the write is applied server-side and the response is destroyed, so the client cannot tell whether it succeeded
results.expected: No silent loss and no duplicate work; the client retries with an idempotency key and reconciliation from the last durable checkpoint proves the observed state matches the intended state
results.residualRisk: low: exactly-once effect is preserved by the idempotency key, but only for clients that send one
